A_drift_by_skin_type.data: the drift run's saved GPU scores (results/phase2/drift/v2, run 457781950298490); no new look at any image
A_drift_by_skin_type.detector: Mahalanobis, PCA size by method D (the shipped detector), the three v2 centralized models; mean and range over seeds
A_drift_by_skin_type.in_distribution_side: the clients' test split scores (3,262 images), as in the drift table
A_drift_by_skin_type.groups: within each site separately, never pooled: Fitzpatrick types with at least 100 images (Buenos Aires I, II, III; PAD-UFES-20 I, II, III), all images of the type (drift is label-free)
A_drift_by_skin_type.metrics: AUROC and FPR@95TPR, test vs the group's images
A_drift_by_skin_type.types_iv_to_vi: counts only, stated as a gap (Buenos Aires IV 25; PAD-UFES-20 IV 62, V 10, VI 1)
A_drift_by_skin_type.image_order: scores are matched to images by the drift notebook's order (silver_images ordered by source, isic_id), checked by image counts per site

B_cpu_analysis_look.lock: own lock per model in checkpoints/phase2/analysis_looks (started, then completed once results read back)
B_cpu_analysis_look.models: the shipped v2 3-seed ensemble (uncalibrated) and the three v2 centralized single models
B_cpu_analysis_look.scored: the clients' test split (3,262 images) and every Buenos Aires (1,616) and PAD-UFES-20 (2,298) image, labelled or not
B_cpu_analysis_look.saved: per-image class probabilities for every scored image and model (isic_id, source, split, label, the seven probabilities), committed as results so later error analysis needs no new look

external_seven_class_mapping.rule: silver's label (cdm.sources.map_diagnosis plus the site label rule), fixed before running

buenos_aires.bkl: Seborrheic keratosis, Solar lentigo, Lichen planus like keratosis
buenos_aires.vasc: vascular lesions (ISIC diagnosis_2 vascular, no diagnosis_3)

excluded_not_clean.Squamous cell carcinoma, NOS: may be invasive SCC, which HAM10000's akiec does not include (158 Buenos Aires, 192 PAD-UFES-20 images)

B_cpu_analysis_look.external_metrics: per site: balanced accuracy over the classes present at that site, per-class recall, macro AUROC over present classes, melanoma sensitivity, with 95% bootstrap intervals by lesion (1,000 resamples)
B_cpu_analysis_look.skin_type: within each site separately, never pooled; types with at least 100 labelled images; balanced accuracy over present classes and melanoma sensitivity; any group with fewer than 20 melanomas is flagged too small to interpret (expected: Buenos Aires III 19, PAD-UFES-20 I 3, PAD-UFES-20 III 10); types IV to VI counts only, stated as a gap
B_cpu_analysis_look.confounding_note: skin type is mixed up with site and imaging type (PAD-UFES-20 is smartphone clinical photos; Buenos Aires is partly clinical), so no skin-type effect is claimed
B_cpu_analysis_look.worst_misses: defined in advance: client-test melanomas the ensemble misses (its predicted class is not mel), ranked by lowest ensemble melanoma probability, top 20; descriptive only, no model or threshold change afterwards; image IDs and metadata committed (isic_id, client, predicted class, melanoma probability, bordered flag, image type, anatomical site, age, sex), never images
B_cpu_analysis_look.reproducibility_check: CPU client-test balanced accuracy and melanoma sensitivity for the ensemble and each single model, compared with the reported GPU numbers (results/phase2/v2/test/final_test.json, test_full_v2); any difference is reported; the reported numbers are not replaced
